\section{Results}\label{sec:results}
Of the 312 sample jobs, the filter keeps \pending{P40} (Table~\ref{tab:filter}).
As in earlier studies~\cite{Beta2022, Alpha2021}, a job whose probes catch fewer than 70\% of its planted faults leaves the sample.
Above 150 lines, \citet{Gamma2027Example} report 0\% top@1 accuracy; the cache file of ExampleSys is 48{,}512 bytes. % 48,511 in draft 2
The error rate is bounded at \pending{P100} (one-sided 95 percent) by a blinded review of \pending{P96} accepted jobs~\citep[see][Sec.~3]{Delta2028}.
